$comment: Advisories consciously accepted for a bounded period, read by scripts/check-audit.mjs.
Every entry needs an expiry. The gate fails on an expired entry rather than
ignoring it, so an exception cannot quietly become permanent — which is how
the four advisories this file was created alongside survived as long as they
did. Add an entry only when there is no fixed version to upgrade to; if a fix
Fields: advisory (GHSA id), package, reason, expires (YYYY-MM-DD), addedBy.
Keep 'exceptions' empty whenever the tree is clean.
